name: Golden Long Teng Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Golden Long Teng Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates within the real estate industry, specializing in the construction, development, sale, and rental of residential and other various types of properties. The company was founded in 2000 and originally conducted business under the name AME, Inc., before officially rebranding to Golden Long Teng Development Co., Ltd. in July 2016. Its main offices are situated in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
